title: The Amount Settled When Premium on a ShieldCare Plan Is Brought Back into Order
content:
## Definition of the amount

Where the customer settles the premium standing on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan, the
amount is defined as follows.

- **The arrears standing on the plan** is the outstanding premium recorded on it.
- **The fees taken with the settlement**: no fee standing on the plan is taken with the settlement,
  and no share of those fees is charged to it.
- **The periods taken ahead of the arrears**: no period ahead of the arrears is taken with the
  settlement, and no discount is allowed on a period taken ahead.
- **The amount the customer settles** is the arrears standing on the plan, together with the share
  charged of the fees taken from it and the periods taken ahead priced at the plan's monthly
  premium less the discount allowed on them, taken to the cent and never below nothing.

The outstanding premium recorded on the plan and the plan's monthly premium are the figures the
plan itself carries.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

A plan carries an outstanding premium of 74.85 and a monthly premium of 14.99.

| Component | Figure |
| --- | --- |
| the arrears standing on the plan | 74.85 |
| the share charged of the fees taken from it | 0.00 |
| the periods taken ahead of the arrears | none, so nothing is priced for them |
| the amount the customer settles, taken to the cent | 74.85 |

Where the outstanding premium recorded on a plan is nothing, the amount the customer settles is
nothing, because the amount is never below nothing.
